title: Which anime character's energy are you?
dek: Luffy, Usagi, Levi, Edward, Gojo, Tanjiro, Naruto or Sakura. Twelve situations, no trivia, and we'll tell you whose energy you're running on this week.

questions.prompt: Episode one. You wake up with a power and no instructions. The nearest person is already running.

options.label: Test the power on something small
Make sure the person running is okay

questions.prompt: Your squad has one room, four beds and a mission at dawn.

options.label: Take the bed by the door
Stay up talking until someone shouts
Redraw the sleeping plan. It's wrong

questions.prompt: A team is only as strong as its weakest member.
I say 'I'm fine' and mean 'ask again'.
A rival has been training for this rematch for six episodes. You forgot it was happening.
Pick the sky you'd wake up under.

options.label: Blossom, pale, very spring
options.alt: Pink blossom against a pale sky

options.label: Stars, cold, no streetlights
options.alt: A starry night sky above a dark horizon

options.label: Sunset, long shadow, end of the arc

questions.prompt: Your mentor quits and leaves you the keys to the dojo.

options.label: Read every scroll before touching anything
Turn it into something nobody expected

questions.prompt: I replay compliments in my head for days.
The best ending is a quiet one.
The final battle is tomorrow. The night before, everyone deals with it differently.

options.label: Take the night off, look incredible

results.name: Monkey D. Luffy
results.tagline: Acts first, crew second, consequences never
results.blurb: You have one goal and no plan, and somehow the plan works. You collect people, feed them, and then accidentally build a movement. Rules slide off you because you never agreed to them in the first place. Your superpower is that you are completely impossible to discourage.
strengths: Doesn't know how to give up
results.watchOut: Someone else is doing the planning you're ignoring. Thank them, then listen.

results.name: Usagi Tsukino
results.blurb: You are not the toughest person in the room and you've stopped pretending. Your power is sincerity: you say the embarrassing true thing, everyone lowers their guard, and the room changes. You also need a nap after every victory, which is fair.
strengths: Recovers from failure with alarming speed
results.watchOut: Being the emotional centre is labour. Let someone take a turn.

results.name: Levi Ackerman
results.blurb: You measure people in what they do, not what they announce. You're abrupt because you're busy, and you're accurate because you've done the reading. The team is stronger when you're in it, though you'd never say that out loud and would prefer nobody mentioned it.
strengths: Calm in the middle of the noise
results.watchOut: Silence + standards reads as cold. Explain the reasoning once in a while.

results.name: Edward Elric
results.tagline: Fixes everything except his own limits
results.blurb: You need to know why, and then you need to make it better. You carry a debt that nobody else can see, and it makes you work harder than is reasonable. You argue with systems, not people — though it doesn't always land that way.
strengths: Refuses to accept the lazy answer
results.watchOut: You can't alchemy your way out of needing rest. Stop at the point of damage.

results.name: Satoru Gojo
results.tagline: Gifted, bored, extremely aware of it
results.blurb: You are very good at things and everyone knows, including you. You keep things light because it's fun and because distance is safe. But when it matters you're serious in a way that surprises people who only know the bit.
strengths: Steps up when it actually counts
results.watchOut: The strongest person in the room is often the loneliest. Let someone carry something.

results.name: Tanjiro Kamado
results.tagline: Kind even when it costs him
results.blurb: You are relentlessly decent. You notice the person at the back, you say thank you, you keep going after the point where most people stop. Your strength is endurance with empathy — you can take a hit and still ask if the other guy is alright.
results.watchOut: Empathy without limits becomes self-erasure. Set one line and mean it.

results.name: Naruto Uzumaki
results.tagline: Announces the outcome, then catches up
results.blurb: You decide you're going to be extraordinary long before the evidence arrives. You're loud about it because the announcement is what keeps you going. People find it exhausting until the day they find it inspiring, and by then you've already done the impossible twice.
strengths: Ambition that survives being laughed at
Loyal to the people who doubted you
results.watchOut: Volume isn't the same as progress. Choose one thing and do it quietly this week.

results.name: Sakura Haruno
results.blurb: You do the emotional labour and the technical labour, and you're often introduced as somebody's friend. Then the difficult thing happens and suddenly you're the only one prepared. You're not interested in being the loudest — you're interested in being right.
strengths: Holds a group together under pressure
Shows up for the boring parts too
results.watchOut: Being capable doesn't mean being available to everyone. Say no before you're empty.
